preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some LineAxis tokens to attempt transfer operations

exploit_hint: Call transfer(), transferFrom(), or approve() functions on the LineAxis contract. These functions do not return boolean values as required by the ERC20 standard (EIP-20). This can cause integration failures with contracts, wallets, or DeFi protocols that expect boolean return values to confirm transaction success. Test by calling these functions through a contract that checks return values - the transaction may succeed but the calling contract won't receive the expected boolean confirmation.
